examples.name: Default
examples.summary: A section heading that links to itself. Hover or focus it to see the underline and the link glyph; neither takes layout. It sits in `DocProse`, which owns the heading type scale; a bare `DocHeading` renders at the surrounding text size.

examples.name: Levels
examples.summary: Levels one to four, each a real heading tag with its own anchor, inside `DocProse` so each level takes its size from the prose scale.
